---
title: "Popularity of the Name Braden"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-braden
#| message: false
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "^yob.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

baby_names <- read_csv(
  files,
  id = "file",
  col_names = c("name", "sex", "count"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(year = parse_number(basename(file))) |>
  select(year, sex, name, count)

# Filter for Braden over the last 100 years and format labels
braden <- baby_names |>
  filter(name == "Braden", year >= 1924) |>
  mutate(sex_label = if_else(sex == "M", "Male", "Female"))

p <- ggplot(braden, aes(
    x = year,
    y = count,
    color = sex_label,
    fill = sex_label,
    group = sex_label,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>Year:</b> ", year, "<br>",
      "<b>Sex:</b> ", sex_label, "<br>",
      "<b>Babies:</b> ", comma(count)
    )
  )) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.25, position = "identity") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Female" = "#e7298a", "Male" = "#2b8cbe")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#e7298a", "Male" = "#2b8cbe")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Popularity of the Name 'Braden' (1924–2023)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Babies",
    color = "Sex",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```
